candidates.text: When a scheduler selects days for recurring tasks using calendar load, keep tasks on their natural cadence dates when availability is tied; only move them to another day when that day has strictly more available budget or the default day is blocked.
candidates.rationale: Story 019 initially collapsed multiple recurring tasks onto the same free day because the score function treated all clear days as equal. Adding a preferred-date tie-breaker restored the Story 017 spread while still allowing calendar-driven moves, which is a reusable heuristic for calendar-aware scheduling.

candidates.text: When a feature adds user-facing explanatory data, include an automated test that demonstrates the data reaches the response or UI contract.
candidates.rationale: The review found that `PlanResult.Reasons` was computed but no test proved it surfaced through `/schedule/plan`. Adding an API-level test caught a gap that unit tests alone did not cover and prevents future regressions where explanations are silently dropped.
